name: Side Leg Swings
instructions: Stand sideways to a wall, holding it for balance.
Swing the outside leg laterally across your body and back.
Keep the torso tall and the swinging leg straight.
Do all reps, then switch sides. A dynamic hip mobility drill.
longevityNotes: A stable trunk protects the spine through every decade. Train the core for endurance and control rather than chasing burn.
overview: Side Leg Swings is a beginner core exercise targeting the abductors, performed with just your bodyweight. A strong trunk stabilizes every lift and protects the spine in daily life.
